context.transcript:
Good afternoon.
You've reached customer service at the Oxbridge Water Company.
How can I help you?
Hi.
I just received my water bill and it's much higher than usual.
I think it's because last month one of the pipes in my house broke.
My whole ground floor was flooded.
I shouldn't have to pay the full amount, should I?
If you can send us a receipt for any repair work related to the leak, it's possible we can reduce the charges.
If you're ready, I can give you the address to send that to.
context.transcript_translation:
下午好。
您已联系到 Oxbridge Water Company 的客户服务部。
请问有什么可以帮您的？
嗨。
我刚收到我的水费账单，比平时高多了。
我想是因为上个月我家的一根管道坏了。
我整个底层都被淹了。
我不应该支付全额款项，对吗？
如果您能给我们提供任何与泄漏相关的维修工作的收据，我们或许可以减少费用。
如果您准备好了，我可以给您发送地址，把这些材料寄过去。
